```plato

    // The query point when it is inside, otherwise the query clamped to the box in
    // the box's own frame and mapped back to world.
    ClosestPoint(b: OrientedBox2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        var q = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Rotation, point);
        var clamped = Vector2D(q.X.Clamp(-hx, hx), q.Y.Clamp(-hy, hy));
        return b.Contains(point) ? point : b.Center + WorldOffset(b.Rotation, clamped);
    }
```

```plato
    // The query point when it lies in the disk, otherwise its radial projection
    // onto the circle.
    ClosestPoint(c: Circle, point: Point2D): Point2D
        => c.Contains(point)
        ? point
        : c.Center + c.Center.Between(point).Normalize * c.Radius;
```

```plato
    // The query point when it lies in the capsule, otherwise the radial projection
    // onto the capsule's boundary from the nearest spine point.
    ClosestPoint(c: Capsule2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var spine = ClosestPointOnSegment(c.A, c.B, point);
        var outward = spine.Between(point);
        return outward.MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square
            ? point
            : spine + outward.Normalize * c.Radius;
    }
```

```plato
    // The query point when it is inside the triangle, otherwise the nearest point
    // of the three edges.
    ClosestPoint(t: Triangle2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
        => t.Contains(point) ? point : t.Points.ClosestPointOnChain(true, point);
```
